title: RTEC Employee Handbook - supplied selected pages
notes: Only eight selected pages of a 48-page handbook were supplied. This record preserves all supplied pages in full but must not be treated as the complete handbook.
The handbook is dated 2023-03-01. Currentness of most provisions is unknown until compared with newer handbook/policy sources.
Page 46 names Sheila Stallsworth as EEO Manager/Officer in 2023. A later signed EEO statement dated 2026-08-26 appoints Jacob Salsman, so the officer assignment has later evidence.
